title: Gaming live stream
description: A complete live streaming brand package for Tiny House Club, a Twitch and YouTube channel dedicated to minimalist living, tiny house design, and intentional lifestyle content. Delivered as a full stream overlay system, animated stinger, social panels, and offline screens.
challenge: Live streaming aesthetics tend toward either high-tech gaming styles or generic template looks. Tiny House Club needed something that felt like the content itself: warm, considered, and distinctly non-corporate.
solution: Designed around natural textures, muted earth tones, and hand-crafted typographic elements. The stinger animation uses a reveal inspired by architectural drawings unfolding — a subtle nod to the tiny house world. Every asset was built in OBS-compatible formats for immediate stream deployment.
result: The rebrand coincided with a 40% increase in average concurrent viewers over the following three months. The visual package has been featured in two 'best stream layouts' round-ups within the Twitch design community.
